acl_applied_to_interfaces.title: ACL Applied to Interfaces
acl_applied_to_interfaces.description: Whether access control lists are applied to all relevant router interfaces (inbound and/or outbound), including segment boundary interfaces, enforcing permit/deny rules at the packet level.

acl_filter_coverage.title: ACL Filter Coverage Scope
acl_filter_coverage.description: The scope of traffic attributes covered by the ACL rules — whether rules filter on source IP, destination IP, protocol, and port, or only a subset.

default_deny_policy.title: Default Deny Policy Enforced
default_deny_policy.description: Whether ACLs end with an explicit or implicit deny-all rule, ensuring that traffic not matching any permit rule is blocked by default. Applies to both general interface ACLs and management interface ACLs.

default_inter_segment_policy.title: Default Inter-Segment Traffic Policy
default_inter_segment_policy.description: The default action applied to inter-segment traffic when no explicit ACL rule matches. Should be 'deny' to enforce least-privilege segmentation.

acl_inter_segment_rules_configured.title: ACL Inter-Segment Rules Configured
acl_inter_segment_rules_configured.description: Indicates whether access control lists or equivalent packet filtering rules explicitly govern traffic crossing between network segments or administrative zones.

prefix_lists_configured.title: Prefix Lists Configured
prefix_lists_configured.description: Indicates whether prefix lists are defined and applied to routing protocol neighbors or interfaces to filter inbound and/or outbound route advertisements.

route_maps_applied.title: Route Maps Applied to BGP/IGP Neighbors
route_maps_applied.description: Indicates whether route maps are applied to routing protocol peers or redistribution points to enforce policy-based filtering and attribute manipulation of route advertisements.

default_route_advertisement_control.title: Default Route Advertisement Control
default_route_advertisement_control.description: Describes how the default route (0.0.0.0/0) advertisement is controlled in routing policy — whether it is explicitly denied, conditionally permitted, or uncontrolled.

inbound_filter_direction_coverage.title: Inbound Route Filter Coverage
inbound_filter_direction_coverage.description: Indicates whether inbound route advertisement filtering (prefix lists or route maps) is applied on all external routing peers, only some peers, or none.

acl_logging_enabled.title: ACL Logging Enabled
acl_logging_enabled.description: Whether logging is configured on ACL entries (permit and/or deny) to capture matched packet flows.

log_destination_configured.title: Log Destination Configured
log_destination_configured.description: Where ACL log messages are sent for persistent storage and analysis.

logged_acl_entry_coverage.title: Logged ACL Entry Coverage
logged_acl_entry_coverage.description: Scope of ACL entries that have logging enabled — whether only deny entries, only permit entries, or both are logged.

acl_direction_coverage.title: ACL Direction Coverage
acl_direction_coverage.description: Indicates which traffic directions have ACL enforcement applied on the interface — both, inbound only, outbound only, or neither. Subsumes separate inbound and outbound boolean attributes.

mgmt_acl_applied.title: Management Interface ACL Applied
mgmt_acl_applied.description: Whether an access control list is applied to the router's management interfaces (e.g., vty lines, console, loopback management interface) restricting inbound access.

permitted_source_scope.title: Permitted Source Address Scope
permitted_source_scope.description: The broadest scope of source addresses permitted to reach management interfaces by the applied ACL.

allowed_mgmt_protocols.title: Allowed Management Protocols
allowed_mgmt_protocols.description: List of protocols explicitly permitted to reach management interfaces (e.g., SSH, HTTPS, SNMP). Insecure protocols such as Telnet or HTTP indicate weaker controls.

qos_policy_configured.title: QoS Policy Configured
qos_policy_configured.description: Indicates whether a Quality of Service policy is actively configured and applied on network interfaces or globally on the router/switch, with priority queuing enabled for at least one critical traffic class.

traffic_classes_defined.title: Number of Traffic Classes Defined
traffic_classes_defined.description: The number of distinct traffic classification entries (class-maps or equivalents) defined within the active QoS policy.

blackhole_routing_enabled.title: Blackhole Routing Enabled
blackhole_routing_enabled.description: Whether null-route/blackhole routing capability is configured and active on the router or routing policy system, allowing traffic to specified prefixes to be dropped at the routing layer.

blackhole_trigger_mechanism.title: Blackhole Trigger Mechanism
blackhole_trigger_mechanism.description: The mechanism by which blackhole routes are activated — static (manually configured), dynamic via BGP RTBH, or automated via orchestration/API.

blackhole_scope.title: Blackhole Enforcement Scope
blackhole_scope.description: Indicates whether blackhole routes are enforced only locally on the device, across the internal network (edge routers), or upstream with ISP/transit provider cooperation.

acl_rules_have_comments.title: ACL Rules Have Descriptive Comments
acl_rules_have_comments.description: Whether all ACL rules and routing policy entries include inline comments or descriptions explaining their purpose, owner, or ticket reference.

stale_rule_review_age_days.title: Days Since Last Stale Rule Review
stale_rule_review_age_days.description: Number of days since the last documented review of ACL rules to identify and remove stale, redundant, or expired entries.

change_tracking_mechanism.title: ACL Change Tracking Mechanism
change_tracking_mechanism.description: The method used to track changes to ACL rules and routing policies over time.
